problems.title: Longest Palindromic Substring
problems.constraints: - **Constraints:** `1≤|s|≤2000`; `s` contains only lowercase English letters.
problems.cpp:
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;int main(){string s;cin>>s;int L=0,R=1;auto f=[&](int l,int r){while(l>=0&&r<(int)s.size()&&s[l]==s[r]){if(r-l+1>R-L){L=l;R=r+1;}--l;++r;}};for(int i=0;i<(int)s.size();i++){f(i,i);f(i,i+1);}cout<<s.substr(L,R-L)<<'\n';}

problems.title: Evaluate Reverse Polish Notation
problems.constraints: - **Constraints:** `1≤n≤1000`; tokens are integers or `+ - * /`; the expression is valid, leaves one result, and never divides by zero; intermediate results fit signed 64-bit.
problems.cpp:
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;int main(){int n;cin>>n;vector<long long>s;string t;while(n--){cin>>t;if(isdigit(t[0])||(t[0]=='-'&&t.size()>1))s.push_back(stoll(t));else{auto b=s.back();s.pop_back();auto a=s.back();s.pop_back();if(t=="+")s.push_back(a+b);if(t=="-")s.push_back(a-b);if(t=="*")s.push_back(a*b);if(t=="/")s.push_back(a/b);}}cout<<s.back()<<'\n';}
